# 2026-09-22 — Reminder Trial Review

> Status: reviewed. Participants: Maya, Jo, Eli. Evidence: [draft message](../sources/reminder-copy.txt) and open slips.

## What was tested

A day-five message names the due date printed on the slip and directs questions to a volunteer. It does not promise a renewal or fee waiver. Eli will count sent messages separately from on-time returns.

## Decisions

Approve one optional day-five reminder for open loans during the pilot. Record as [D-02](../decisions.md#decision-log), not as a change to [D-01](../decisions.md#decision-log).

## Actions

Maya sends the reviewed text for eligible slips; Eli reconciles the batch with the ledger. The current steps are in the [reminder workflow](../kb/reminder-workflow.md#current-workflow).
